generator.lateral_rule: Ag xy was generated at (i+0.37)*unit_cell_a + (j+0.21)*unit_cell_b for i,j in {0,1}; this is a synthetic builder choice, not a source-verified or energetically selected registry.

termination.note: The topmost substrate layer under the Ag monolayer is Si; this confirms the proposed cut termination, not a validated relaxed interface.

registry.basis: synthetic placement in build_from_cif.py; no paper-coordinate file or relaxed structure confirms this registry

d0.definition_candidate: Mean z of the topmost terminating Si plane to mean z of the Ag plane, measured along the surface normal.
d0.evidence: The 2.6 A value is a manually assigned unrelaxed construction gap in manifest.json/build_from_cif.py. No verified relaxation or source-qualified numerical equilibrium distance is present.

Ag_layer_motion.proposed_endpoint_rule: Rigidly translate all four Ag atoms together by -0.10 A or +0.10 A along Cartesian z relative to the fixed substrate; hold cell and lateral registry fixed.
Ag_layer_motion.rule_source: candidate definition from the existing reviewed DFT plan; not yet embodied in released endpoint files

release_blockers: The candidate is derived from the COD/Kisi parent family already used in historical Ag-Si scoring; it is not an independent DEV parent.
The lateral registry is generated by arbitrary fractional offsets and has no source or relaxation evidence.
The 2.6 A gap is an unrelaxed builder input, not a verified equilibrium d0.
No d0 or d0±0.10 A endpoint geometries and endpoint hashes are frozen.
The periodic empty z clearance is 16.00026725 A, below the previously reviewed 18 A target; a vacuum convergence comparison is absent.
The existing candidate carries PBC true,true,true and must not be silently rewritten to a different cell/PBC convention.

next_release_gates: Provide a source-qualified, genuinely independent Ti3SiC2 parent and define whether its role is DEV; keep all variants grouped by that parent family.
Provide a source-qualified, genuinely independent Ag-Si interface parent with explicit atom coordinates, termination, and defensible registry.
Define d0 from a reproducible, source-qualified relaxed structure or separately approved physical reference; generate and hash the fixed d0 and rigid Ag-layer endpoint files.
Review slab cell/PBC and require at least the approved vacuum thickness plus its convergence comparison before input freeze.
Only after source and geometry gates pass, issue a new configuration; this document does not authorize DFT.
